name: reel-001-437
description: Reel 001 "437": a 40-second Instagram reel where every frame is drawn by three.js in headless Chrome, voiced by local Kokoro TTS and scored in Python.
author: Rithik Gour

scripts.encode: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('out',{recursive:true})" && ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 -i frames/f%05d.png -i audio/mix.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 17 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/reel.mp4
